lessons.name: twinkle_twinkle
lessons.title: Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star
lessons.instructions: C position, but the A in bar two is one key above it: stretch finger 5 up to A and bring it back to G. Everything else stays under the hand.
tips: When finger 5 reaches for A, keep the thumb resting on C.
Bars 5-8 are the same shape twice — learn them once.
